'''Toonbuck Toora''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[Sy Myrthian]] [[senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> representing her [[homeworld]] of [[Sy Myrth]].<ref name="Geektionary French" /> She was present in the Senate along with her [[aide]], [[Ianad Cisma]], within the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] when [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of the planet [[Naboo]] addressed the Senate to resolve the [[Trade Federation]]'s [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of her [[homeworld]].<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" />

Along with Senators [[Passel Argente]] and [[Orn Free Taa]], Toora played a vital role in the downfall of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]],<ref name="Chancellors, Senators and Other Statesmen of the Republic">{{EncyclopediaCite|Chancellors, Senators and States Persons of the Republic}}</ref> who was deposed when Amidala called for a [[Vote of No Confidence]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Among many other important senators, Toora came to support the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a separatist state lead by the [[Count of Serenno]], [[Dooku]].<ref name="OF84">{{GermanFanCite|84|Database}}</ref> Toora wore a brown [[Clothing|dress]] with hanging sleeve detail.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" />
